map.选择作业或场所场景，工具一键生成对应隐患排查清单，可跟踪每项整改进度、统计闭环率: Select a work or site scenario and the tool generates the matching hazard checklist with one click; you can track correction progress for each item, compute the closure rate and export, with data saved locally, for daily enterprise safety management and audit trails.
map.建立可复用的隐患排查清单模板，覆盖消防、电气、机械、化学品等维度，统一检查标准。: Build a reusable hazard inspection checklist template covering fire safety, electrical, mechanical and chemical dimensions to unify inspection standards.
map.每次巡检按清单打勾，自动汇总未达标项并指派整改。: Tick off the checklist on each inspection round; non-conforming items are automatically aggregated and assigned for correction.
map.留存历史检查记录，对比各期闭环情况，识别反复出现的同类隐患。: Keep historical inspection records and compare closure across periods to identify recurring hazards of the same type.
map.：清单按区域/设备拆项为可勾选检查点（如灭火器压力、配电箱漏保、急停按钮有效）；: : The checklist is broken down by area/equipment into tickable check points (for example extinguisher pressure, distribution box residual current device, emergency stop button working); unchecked items are counted as non-conforming, aggregated into a pending correction list whose progress is tracked until acceptance.
map.：月度巡检清单 30 项，本月不合格 4 项（消防 2、电气 1、机械 1），指: : The monthly inspection checklist has 30 items; 4 failed this month (2 fire, 1 electrical, 1 mechanical). After assigning owners, 3 were closed within two weeks and 1 electrical item slips to next month because of a procurement delay; compared with 6 failures last month, the trend is improving.
map.清单检查标准为什么要统一？: Why should checklist standards be unified?
map.统一检查项与判定标准可避免不同人员松紧不一，使各期数据可比，便于发现系统性薄弱环: Unifying inspection items and acceptance criteria avoids different inspectors being lax or strict, makes data comparable across periods, and helps reveal systemic weak points.
map.反复出现的同类隐患怎么处理？: How should recurring hazards of the same type be handled?
map.归因为根因（如设备老化、培训不足），升级为工程改造或制度修订，而非重复局部整改。: Attribute it to a root cause (such as equipment ageing or insufficient training) and escalate to engineering modification or procedure revision, rather than repeating local fixes.
